evidence: evals/launch-readiness/evals.json and scripts/lib/launch-evals.mjs require seven dimensions, four human authorities, reopen review, disagreements, and structured overrides.

scripts/lib/repo-evidence-path.mjs performs lexical containment without realpath or symlink containment, so an approved-root symlink can redirect retained evidence outside the repository.

evals/_shared/contract.json keeps five external human gates explicit and modelHasFinalReleaseAuthority false.
criterionResults.rationale: The decision vector and human-authority policy are visible, but enforcement remains incomplete: ordering, evidence provenance, smoke semantics, and private-path controls can be bypassed while aggregate certification appears valid.
risks: Two holdouts can be counted before deterministic qualification of the candidate.
A semantically failed production smoke can be represented as passed structured evidence.
Symlinked log or browser-report paths can import evidence from outside the approved repository roots.
Deeply encoded private paths can enter intake or canonical records undetected.
Reviewer independence is a process attestation with user-supplied UUID and label, not cryptographic identity proof; docs acknowledge this limitation.
Candidate-authored archival reports remain derived evidence and must not be mistaken for independent corroboration.

blockingFindings.title: The stop condition does not enforce deterministic-pass-before-holdout sequencing
evidence: scripts/lib/eval-contract.mjs:341-370 filters all current accepted holdouts and all deterministic runs, then combines counts without comparing their sequence positions.
A read-only adversarial probe ordered holdout A, holdout B, deterministic pass 1, deterministic pass 2 and returned acceptedForReview true.
blockingFindings.impact: Independent reviewers can certify a candidate before the deterministic gate has qualified it, contrary to docs/evals/composite-governance.md:47-58 and the intended recursive review protocol.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Require the certifying phase to contain two consecutive deterministic passes followed by two distinct governed holdouts for the unchanged candidate, and add negative tests for holdouts before or interleaved with those passes.

blockingFindings.title: Production smoke evidence validates shape but not success
evidence: scripts/lib/launch-evals.mjs validateGateEvidence only requires the HTTP observation keys to be present and nonempty.
A read-only probe supplied apex 500, www 500, tls false, health 503, canonicals false, and openGraph false; validation returned an empty error list.
blockingFindings.impact: LR-HG-PRODUCTION-SMOKE can be recorded as passed while its own structured evidence reports a failed deployment.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Define and validate passing types and values for every HTTP observation and require robots/sitemap evidence to satisfy the declared production policy rather than substring presence.

blockingFindings.title: Approved evidence roots can be escaped through symlinks
evidence: scripts/lib/repo-evidence-path.mjs:10-34 normalizes and resolves the path lexically but does not compare realpath results for the evidence file and approved root.
scripts/lib/eval-contract.mjs and scripts/lib/launch-evals.mjs subsequently use existsSync/readFileSync on the unresolved symlink path.
blockingFindings.impact: A generated log or browser-report symlink under an approved directory can bind a digest to an external file, defeating the stated repository evidence boundary.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Reject symlink components or require realpath containment beneath a realpath-resolved approved root before reading or hashing evidence.

blockingFindings.title: Deep percent encoding bypasses private-path detection
evidence: scripts/lib/security-normalization.mjs:13-25 decodes at most eight times.
A read-only probe showed containsPrivatePath true for one through eight encodings of /Users/jamie/private.txt and false at nine and ten encodings.
blockingFindings.impact: Intake or canonical knowledge fields can retain a reversibly encoded private locator despite the public-safety invariant.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Decode until stable with a defensible size/iteration fail-closed limit, and reject input that remains percent-encoded at the limit; add the nine-layer mutation.
